posts.content:
LIGEN POWER Lithium Ion Battery Pack Assembly Process

Precision · Safety · Performance


Based on the official LIGEN POWER assembly workflow, here’s a step-by-step breakdown of how their lithium battery packs are manufactured:

Manufacturing & Assembly Steps 1. Cell Inspection

All individual cells are tested for voltage, internal resistance, and appearance. This ensures only premium-grade cells enter the production line.

2. Cell Sorting & Matching

Cells are sorted and matched to ensure consistent capacity and performance. This prevents imbalance and extends overall pack life.

3. Cell Arrangement

Cells are arranged in series and parallel configurations as per the pack design to achieve the required voltage and capacity.

4. Nickel Strip Welding

Nickel strips are precision welded to connect cells electrically. This creates the main current paths with low resistance.

5. BMS Installation

The Battery Management System is installed to monitor and protect the battery pack. It handles overcharge, over-discharge, short circuit, and temperature protection.

6. Wiring & Connection

Power cables and signal wires are connected securely. Proper routing and insulation are critical for safety and reliability.

7. Insulation & Protection

Insulation materials are applied to prevent short circuits and ensure operational safety. This includes barrier sheets and heat-resistant tape.

8. Enclosure Installation

The battery pack is placed into the protective enclosure and secured. The casing provides structural integrity and environmental protection.

9. Final Assembly

Handles, connectors, labels, and accessories are installed. This prepares the pack for real-world use and compliance labeling.

10. Testing & Quality Check

Functions, voltage, capacity, protection, and appearance are fully tested. Every pack must pass rigorous testing before approval.

11. Packaging

The pack is protected with foam and packed securely to prevent transit damage.

12. Ready to Deliver

High-quality lithium battery packs are now ready to power your world.


Key Manufacturing Pillars: Premium Cells → Smart BMS → Precise Assembly → Rigorous Testing → Safe & Reliable

posts.title: LIGEN POWER 48V 30Ah Lithium Battery Pack Assembly
posts.excerpt: LIGEN POWER 48V 30Ah Lithium Battery Pack Assembly
posts.author: Admin
posts.content:
LIGEN POWER 48V 30Ah Lithium Battery Pack Assembly - Step by Step Guide

Configuration: 16S2P | Cell Type: LiFePO4 Cylindrical Cell 15Ah | Energy: 1440Wh


The LIGEN POWER 48V 30Ah battery uses a 16 Series 2 Parallel setup with 32 total cells. Here’s how the pack is assembled, based on the manufacturer’s process:


Assembly Process


1. Cell Inspection 

Inspect all cylindrical LiFePO4 cells for damage, leakage, or physical abnormalities. Check each cell’s voltage to ensure consistency across the batch. Reject any cell outside tolerance.


2. Cell Pairing (2P) 

Place 2 cells in parallel to form a 2P group. Use cell holders or spacers to maintain uniform spacing and prevent shorts. This doubles the capacity of each group to 30Ah.


3. Build 2P Modules (16 Groups) 

Build 16 identical 2P modules. Total cells required: 32 cells. Each module will represent one “series” stage of the final pack.


4. Connect 2P with Nickel Strips 

Connect the two cells in each 2P pair using nickel strips. Spot welding is recommended for low resistance and strong mechanical bonding. Ensure tight, clean welds.


5. Arrange 16S 

Arrange the 16 groups in series (16S) following correct polarity from B- to B+. Connect groups using nickel strips to achieve nominal 48V. Double-check orientation before welding.


7. Check Series Connection 

Verify total voltage. For LiFePO4, expect ∼51.2V at rest. Confirm all connections are tight and polarity is correct throughout the string. Test continuity before proceeding.


8. Add Insulation + Install BMS 

Install a 16S 60A LiFePO4 BMS. Connect balance leads to each series point. Connect P- to B-, P+ to B+. Add insulation layers between cells and BMS to prevent shorts and thermal issues.


9. Enclosure Installation 

Place the assembled battery pack into the metal enclosure. Secure and fix the pack properly using brackets or padding to prevent movement, vibration damage, or stress on welds.


10. Connect Output Terminals 

Connect main output terminals: P+ (positive) and P- (negative). Ensure connections are torqued and tight to handle high current without heating.


11. Final Check 

Check total voltage (∼51.2V) and BMS indicators. Test output under load for proper operation, cut-off, and balancing. Verify charge/discharge function before sealing.


12. Complete Battery Pack 

The 48V 30Ah LiFePO4 Battery Pack in 16S2P configuration is now complete. Ready for labeling, QA, and deployment.


Important Safety Note

Battery assembly involves high current and spot welding. Only trained technicians with proper PPE and equipment should attempt this. Incorrect assembly can cause fire, explosion, or injury.

posts.title: How Lithium Batteries are transforming Energy Storage.
posts.meta_description: LIGEN POWER manufactures lithium-ion battery packs, LFP energy storage solutions, BMS systems and renewable energy products for customers across India.
posts.author: Admin
posts.content:
Lithium Battery Manufacturer and Energy Storage Solutions


LIGEN POWER is a leading lithium battery manufacturer in India specializing in lithium-ion battery packs, battery management systems, EV battery packs, portable power stations and renewable energy storage solutions.


Lithium batteries are transforming energy storage by enabling the large-scale adoption of renewable energy, stabilizing electrical grids, and powering electric mobility—primarily through their unmatched efficiency (90–95%), high energy density, and long lifespan (up to 10+ years) compared to traditional lead-acid batteries (70–80% efficiency, 2–3 year lifespan).

The key driving forces behind the transformation and rapid adoption of Lithium-Ion Batteries (Li-ion batteries) are:

1. Growing Demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs)

The global shift toward cleaner transportation has significantly increased demand for lithium-ion batteries. EV manufacturers require batteries with:

  • Higher energy density
  • Longer driving range
  • Faster charging capability
  • Lower weight

2. Renewable Energy Storage Requirements

As solar and wind energy installations increase, efficient energy storage systems are needed to store power during periods of excess generation and supply it when required. Lithium-ion batteries have become the preferred solution due to their:

  • High efficiency
  • Fast response time
  • Long cycle life

3. Reduction in Battery Costs

Advancements in manufacturing processes, economies of scale, and improved supply chains have dramatically reduced battery costs over the past decade, making lithium-ion technology more accessible for:

  • EVs
  • Home energy storage
  • Industrial applications
  • Portable electronics

4. Technological Advancements

Continuous research has improved:

  • Energy density
  • Battery Management Systems (BMS)
  • Safety features
  • Charging speed
  • Thermal management

Emerging technologies such as solid-state batteries and advanced lithium chemistries are further transforming the industry.

5. Government Policies and Environmental Regulations

Governments worldwide are encouraging clean energy adoption through:

  • EV subsidies
  • Carbon emission targets
  • Renewable energy mandates
  • Battery manufacturing incentives

These policies accelerate investment and innovation in lithium-ion battery technology.

6. Consumer Electronics Growth

The widespread use of:

  • Smartphones
  • Laptops
  • Tablets
  • Wearable devices
  • EV-Communiting Options

has continuously pushed manufacturers to develop batteries that are lighter, smaller, and more powerful.

7. Focus on Sustainability and Circular Economy

The industry is increasingly investing in:

  • Battery recycling
  • Second-life battery applications
  • Sustainable material sourcing
  • Reduced dependence on critical minerals

This transformation aims to lower environmental impact while ensuring long-term resource availability.

8. Advances in Battery Chemistry

New chemistries such as:

  • Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP)
  • Nickel Manganese Cobalt (NMC)
  • Nickel Cobalt Aluminum (NCA)

offer improved performance, safety, and cost-effectiveness for different applications.


Conclusion

The transformation of lithium-ion batteries is being driven by the convergence of electrification of transport, renewable energy integration, technological innovation, cost reduction, sustainability goals, and supportive government policies. These factors are making lithium-ion batteries the backbone of the global transition toward clean energy and sustainable mobility.

posts.title: Mobile Solar Ironing Cart: A Smart, Sustainable & Inverter-Free Solution for Modern Ironing Services
posts.author: Ligen Power Team
posts.content:
Revolutionizing Mobile Ironing with Solar Energy

As the world moves toward sustainable and energy-efficient solutions, the Mobile Solar Ironing Cart emerges as an innovative answer for laundry entrepreneurs, ironing service providers, institutions, and rural communities. Designed to operate completely on Direct Current (DC) power, this system eliminates the need for traditional inverters, reducing energy losses while providing reliable ironing performance.

The Mobile Solar Ironing Cart combines high-efficiency solar panels, MPPT charge control technology, and a LiFePO₄ lithium battery bank to deliver uninterrupted ironing services even in areas with unreliable grid power.

Why the Mobile Solar Ironing Cart?

Traditional ironing businesses often face challenges such as:

  • High electricity costs
  • Frequent power outages
  • Dependence on diesel generators
  • Limited mobility
  • High maintenance expenses

The Mobile Solar Ironing Cart addresses these issues by offering:

·        100% Solar-Powered Operation

·        Inverter-Free Direct DC System

·        Silent & Eco-Friendly Performance

·        Portable and Easy to Move

·        Low Maintenance LiFePO₄ Battery Technology

·        Reduced Operating Costs

System Overview

The system consists of four major components:

1. Solar Power Generation

Two high-efficiency Mono PERC solar panels generate clean energy throughout the day.

Recommended Capacity

  • 800W – 1.1kW Solar Array
  • Example Configuration:
  • 2 × 550W Solar Panels
  • Total Capacity: 1100W

Daily Energy Generation

  • Approx. 4–5 kWh/day (depending on sunlight conditions)


2. MPPT Solar Charge Controller

An advanced MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) controller ensures maximum energy harvesting from solar panels.

Specifications

  • Rating: 40A – 60A
  • System Voltage: 24V DC
  • Technology: MPPT/PWM Compatible

Benefits

  • Higher charging efficiency
  • Faster battery charging
  • Better performance under varying sunlight conditions
  • Enhanced battery life

3. Lithium Battery Energy Storage

·        The system incorporates a robust 24V 150Ah LiFePO₄ Battery Bank.

Technical Specifications

Advantages of LiFePO₄ Technology

  • Long service life
  • Faster charging
  • Deep discharge capability
  • Lightweight compared to lead-acid batteries
  • Enhanced safety features

4. DC Ironing Load

The system is optimized for direct DC ironing applications.

Supported Iron Ratings

  • 400W DC Iron
  • 600W DC Iron
  • Solar Steam Iron (24V DC)

Preferred Load Range

  • 400W – 600W

System Flow Diagram

Solar Panels → MPPT Controller → Lithium Battery → DC Iron

This direct DC architecture eliminates inverter losses, resulting in:

  • Improved efficiency
  • Lower equipment cost
  • Reduced maintenance
  • Longer battery backup

Recommended Technical Specifications

Estimated Backup Performance

Actual performance may vary based on battery condition, solar irradiance, and operating environment.

Designed for Multiple Applications

Laundry & Ironing Businesses

Perfect for independent ironing vendors seeking to reduce electricity expenses.

Residential Communities

Can be deployed in apartment complexes for community ironing services.

Hotels & Resorts

Ideal for outdoor service stations and eco-friendly hospitality initiatives.

Educational Institutions

Provides sustainable utility services while promoting renewable energy awareness.

Rural & Remote Areas

Ensures uninterrupted ironing operations where grid connectivity is weak or unavailable.

Key Marketing Advantages

Reduce Operating Costs

By harnessing solar energy, businesses can significantly lower monthly electricity bills.

Increase Profitability

Lower energy expenses directly improve operating margins.

Go Green

Demonstrate commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility.

Mobility & Flexibility

Heavy-duty wheels allow easy transportation and deployment.

Silent Operation

Unlike generators, the system operates without noise or emissions.

Reliable Performance

LiFePO₄ batteries ensure dependable backup power for continuous operation.

Return on Investment (ROI)

A conventional ironing station consumes substantial electricity annually. By switching to a solar-powered mobile ironing cart:

  • Energy costs can be drastically reduced.
  • Dependence on the electrical grid is minimized.
  • Maintenance expenses remain low.
  • Battery life extends over several years.

This makes the Mobile Solar Ironing Cart not only an environmentally responsible choice but also a financially rewarding investment.

Future-Ready Ironing Solution

The Mobile Solar Ironing Cart represents the next generation of sustainable ironing infrastructure. Combining renewable energy, lithium battery technology, and direct DC operation, it delivers an efficient, reliable, and cost-effective solution for businesses and institutions seeking energy independence.

Empowering entrepreneurs, reducing energy costs, and promoting clean energy, one ironed garment at a time.
